name: Sealed Note to Watcher Backus
summary: In Stormwind, Elling Trias sends a sealed note to Watcher Backus in Duskwood. He asks the Night Watch guard to report Defias activity near Darkshire.

sections.title: A Word for the Watch
sections.body: Elling Trias agrees to use his contacts to help search for the missing diplomat. He seals a note for Watcher Backus, a Night Watch guard stationed in Duskwood. Trias sends a traveler south through the forest to deliver it by hand. He hopes Backus will report any Defias seen near Darkshire.

sections.title: Trias's Far-Reaching Eyes
sections.body: Elling Trias sells cheese in Stormwind's Trade District and keeps contacts beyond the city. His note reaches Watcher Backus, a guard of Darkshire's wary Night Watch. The town faces threats from undead and savage beasts, yet Backus receives Trias's message warmly. Their bond shows that Trias has earned respect beyond Stormwind.

aliases: who wrote sealed note to watcher backus
faq.answer: Elling Trias wrote the note. He owns Trias' Cheese in Stormwind City's Trade District and secretly works as a spy and information broker.

faq.q: Why is it being sent to Watcher Backus?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus serves in Darkshire's Night Watch and is a trusted contact of Elling Trias. Trias asks him to report local sightings or rumors of Defias Brotherhood activity around Duskwood.

faq.q: Where can Watcher Backus be found?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus patrols the road just north of Darkshire in Duskwood, watching the forest approaches to town.

faq.q: What happens after the note is delivered?
faq.answer: Backus recognizes Trias's name and trusts his request. He sets aside his usual caution toward travelers and agrees to help investigate suspicious activity in the woods.

angles.text: The note shows how personal ties and informal intelligence help hold the Alliance's frayed territories together when official channels fail.
Trias relies on an ordinary guard for local information, a way to gather intelligence far beyond city walls.
